title: Digital Lab: Improving agent behavior using reinforcement learning from traces
description:
AI agents often work, but their behavior can be inconsistent or hard to control with prompts alone. In this hands-on lab, you will start with a working agent, inspect execution traces, define “good behavior” using evaluation graders, and apply reinforcement learning to reinforce better decisions. By the end, you’ll have a practical workflow for improving agent behavior using feedback from agent runs, without redesigning your agent from scratch.

This is a self-paced, digitally-delivered lab experience that you complete on your own schedule. Click the 'Launch' button to start the lab, and then after authentication, follow the instructions listed on the lab page to complete the activity. For technical issues or support, please contact the support team via this link: https://skill.info/build26labsupport.
